bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 60
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:startless-batch-db17)" || exit 61
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 62
before="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT chat_id||':'||thread_id||':'||message_id||':'||owner_user_id||':'||synced_revision FROM profile_publications WHERE status='published' AND message_id>0 ORDER BY chat_id,thread_id,message_id;")" || exit 63
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$before" | wc -l)" -eq 7 || exit 64
test "$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM startless_public_post_migrations;")" = 0 || exit 65
dry="$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/refreshStartlessExistingPosts.mjs --dry-run)" || exit 66
printf '%s\n' "$dry"
printf '%s\n' "$dry" | grep -Fq '"selected":95' || exit 67
printf '%s\n' "$dry" | grep -Fq '"uncertain":0' || exit 68
if result="$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/refreshStartlessExistingPosts.mjs --apply)";then
 printf '%s\n' "$result"
else
 echo STARTLESS_APPLY_PARTIAL_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED
 exit 69
fi
printf '%s\n' "$result" | grep -Fq '"selected":15' || exit 70
printf '%s\n' "$result" | grep -Fq '"applied":15' || exit 71
printf '%s\n' "$result" | grep -Fq '"uncertain":0' || exit 72
states="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT state||'='||count(*) FROM startless_public_post_migrations GROUP BY state ORDER BY state;")" || exit 73
printf '%s\n' "$states"
test "$states" = "applied=15" || exit 74
after="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT chat_id||':'||thread_id||':'||message_id||':'||owner_user_id||':'||synced_revision FROM profile_publications WHERE status='published' AND message_id>0 ORDER BY chat_id,thread_id,message_id;")" || exit 75
test "$before" = "$after" || exit 76
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 77
echo STARTLESS_FIRST_BATCH_APPLIED=15_OF_95
echo ORIGINAL_PROFILE_POST_IDS=UNCHANGED
echo POST_DELETION_OR_REPOST=NONE
